blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, secure jet ski ports, or dock at boat slips. The RV park has 72 full hook-up sites with water, electric, and sewer, open year-round except a short closure after Thanksgiving. Amenities include a sanitary dump station, handicap-accessible bathhouse, coin laundry, fire rings, picnic tables, boat launch, horseshoe pit, basketball court, and games.
